description.value: A small-town public library housed in the historic Library and Pioneer Museum Building in Hazelton, in the Upper Skeena region. Beyond books, it features a Pioneer Museum, an art collection, and a local history reference collection that document the area's heritage. Touring cyclists will find free Wi-Fi, computer access, and a welcoming rest stop in a remote stretch of northern BC.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active public library (© 2026, upcoming events in May 2026) housed in a historic Library and Pioneer Museum Building. Wi-Fi is supported by both the OSM tag internet_access=wlan and the website's 'Computer & Internet Use' service listing. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, water refill, or washrooms. Contact details (phone, address) match between OSM and the website.
concerns: OSM opening hours do not match the hours shown on the library's website; website hours appear more current
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active public library with free Wi-Fi, a Pioneer Museum, and local history collection in a remote northern BC community where services are scarce. A valuable rest and information stop for touring cyclists on the Highway 16 corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Main floor is wheelchair accessible per the group tours page. The library also includes a 'Library of Things' lending program and offers group tours of the building and museum.

wow_evidence: Library sharing its historic building with a Pioneer Museum and art collection — more than an ordinary branch stop.
blurb: Hazelton's library in the historic Library and Pioneer Museum building.
